source: 2026-09-19 XISO, two runs per role, same suite leaf ID/revision/iteration contract
metric: Guest average microseconds per leaf; lower is better. Positive speedup = 100 * (control latency / candidate latency - 1). Two-run speedup uses the arithmetic mean latency of each role.
limits: Live guest markers were unavailable. Percentages are descriptive, not PR-grade timing proof. Runs were role-blocked, not interleaved. Failed, unreached, or functional-hash-mismatched leaves have no speedup value.
